title: Typical-Stay Base of the Short-Stay Share — Roamhaven Listings Pricing Method
content:
# Typical-Stay Base of the Short-Stay Share

*Pricing method for Roamhaven Listings, read from the host's Host Accounts record.*

## Method

The typical-stay base of a listing's short-stay share is read from the most recent Superhost assessment recorded on the host account (the Host Accounts record of the host who owns the listing), using the completed stays and completed nights that assessment counted. The account's **average stay** is its completed nights divided by its completed stays.

| Most recent Superhost assessment on the host account | Typical-stay base |
|---|---|
| counted **10 or more** completed stays | the standard short-stay share (0.50) plus 0.50 multiplied by the space type's short-stay night limit divided by the account's average stay, that last fraction counted as 1 when it is above 1 |
| counted **at least one but fewer than 10** completed stays | the standard short-stay share (0.50) plus 0.50 multiplied by the space type's short-stay night limit divided by the space type's weekly-discount figure in nights |
| no Superhost assessment on the host account, or the most recent one counted **no** completed stays | the standard short-stay share alone |


## Worked cases (hypothetical; space type with a 2-night short-stay limit and a 7-night weekly figure)

1. **20 completed stays, 70 completed nights.** Average stay: 70 divided by 20 is 3.5 nights. Fraction: 2 divided by 3.5 is 0.571428…, not above 1. Base: 0.50 plus 0.50 multiplied by 0.571428… is 0.785714….
2. **15 completed stays, 24 completed nights.** Average stay: 1.6 nights. Fraction: 2 divided by 1.6 is 1.25, above 1, so it is counted as 1. Base: 0.50 plus 0.50 is 1.00.
3. **4 completed stays.** At least one but fewer than 10. Base: 0.50 plus 0.50 multiplied by 2 divided by 7, that is 0.50 plus 0.142857…, giving 0.642857….
4. **10 completed stays, 40 completed nights.** 10 is "10 or more". Average stay 4 nights; fraction 0.5; base 0.75.
5. **Most recent assessment counted 0 completed stays** (an earlier one counted 12). Only the most recent assessment is read, so the base is the standard short-stay share alone.
